dedupe_keys.name: 新横浜駅屋内地図オーフンテータ railways and stations

description: 新横浜駅屋内地図オープンデータ [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 政策統括官. 国土交通省が実施している、「高精度測位社会プロジェクト」の実証実験において作成した新横浜駅の屋内地図です。 実証実験に用いた屋内地図のうち、通路や部屋の範囲などの基盤となる地図、歩行空間ネットワークデータ、トイレ・エレベータ等公共設備POIのデータを公開しています。 データのダウンロードは、ユーザ登録の後、 ログイン状態で行ってくだ... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 政策統括官. Its tags are 不動産建設経済局, 地理空間情報活用推進基本計画, 屋内地図, 情報活用推進課, 政策統括官. It offers 8 resource(s) in jpeg, pdf, shp, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (compatible with CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
